capabilities: Insert a todos widget into a note via command or code block
Add, edit, complete, and delete tasks without writing YAML
Track Todo/Doing/Completed states and cycle P0-P2 priorities
Set due dates with overdue highlighting and link tasks to source notes
Collapse lists and completed sections per pane
extras: Tasks live in a kanso-todos code block, not Markdown checkboxes, so they are not indexed by the Tasks plugin, Datav task queries, or Obsidian checkbox search, and the plugin does not aggregate tasks across the vault; there is no settings page, and the README links a donation page.
problem: Keeping task lists next to their related notes usually means writing and maintaining Markdown checkboxes or YAML by hand, with no compact visual widget.
summary: Embeds a compact interactive task-list widget in notes, storing tasks as YAML in a code block with status, priority, and due dates.
